criteria.name: Account & warehouse setup
criteria.description: Right-sized warehouse with auto-suspend and auto-resume; clean database and schema hierarchy for the running project; credit-aware choices explained.

criteria.name: RBAC & least privilege
criteria.description: Custom roles inherit into SYSADMIN; grants are least-privilege, including a future grant; no work is done as ACCOUNTADMIN once roles exist.

criteria.name: Policies & governance
criteria.description: Masking and row access policies verified under two roles; policies and lineage located in Horizon; tag-based masking explained, not just named.

criteria.name: Data protection & semi-structured data
criteria.description: Time Travel and UNDROP recovery demonstrated; clone independence proven; nested JSON queried with dot notation and FLATTEN.

criteria.name: Ingestion design
criteria.description: Idempotent COPY INTO, a working Snowpipe kept separate from bulk loads, and a decision table that picks one tool per scenario with a reason.

criteria.name: Incremental pipelines
criteria.description: Stream + Task MERGE handles inserts, updates and deletes correctly; Dynamic Table pipeline refreshes within its lag; trade-offs defended.

criteria.name: Transformation & modeling
criteria.description: Silver and Gold built in SQL and Snowpark with deduplication and window functions; a UDF and stored procedure that actually get used.

criteria.name: Orchestration & CI/CD
criteria.description: Three-step DAG with a serverless task, a deployed dbt project with a diagnosed failure, and migrations promoted to dev and prod through GitHub Actions.

criteria.name: Performance & cost
criteria.description: Query Profile diagnosis grounded in real statistics (spill, cache, pruning); Resource Monitor in place; concrete fixes proposed.

criteria.name: Self-service analytics
criteria.description: Dashboard, Streamlit app and Cortex Analyst all read governed Gold tables; generated SQL was checked for accuracy.

criteria.name: Features & Feature Store
criteria.description: EDA drives feature choices; entity and FeatureView registered with a timestamp; training set is point-in-time correct.

criteria.name: Model quality & evaluation
criteria.description: Tuned with GridSearchCV; the metric matches the business problem and is justified; improvement over the baseline is measured, not assumed.

criteria.name: Registry & deployment
criteria.description: Versioned model with a default alias, batch predictions written to Gold, real-time path documented, and a concrete drift-monitoring plan.

criteria.name: Retrieval & grounding
criteria.description: Cortex Search returns relevant chunks; RAG answers are checked for grounding and failures are explained.

criteria.name: Agent design & tool routing
criteria.description: The agent picks correctly between Cortex Analyst, Cortex Search and the custom tool across all 5 test questions, with the evidence logged.

criteria.name: Governance, cost & security
criteria.description: Cost review names 3 concrete savings; Trust Center findings are prioritized; RBAC covers every Cortex object.

criteria.name: Architecture narrative
criteria.description: The bronze-to-agent walkthrough is coherent, accurate and portfolio-ready.

criteria.name: Certification plan
criteria.description: Capstone components are mapped to exam domains, with a realistic 1-week plan for the gaps.
